title: Banu ka tha nauha aaja ali asghar
body:
Aja Ali asger (2)
Banu ka Tha noha Aja Ali asger
Banu ka Tha noha Aja Ali asger (1)
1) phool sa naazuk jism Tere
Aaaga oogalta Hai sehra
Teen Dino se hai tujh ek qatra Pani na Mila phat jaata Hai Dil mere
Aja Ali asgher banu ka Tha noha Aja Ali. Asger
2). Chajaaye GI tariki suraj doobne walaa Hai
Ooudti Hai khake karbobala Charo taraf sannata Hai
Aye se Mai tu tanha Hai
Aja Ali asgher banu ka Tha noha Aja Ali asger
3) nehr kinaare Tere chacha maqtal Mai Tere bhaiya
Baap ka SAR Hai tanse juda bistar par Bhai Hai Tere
Kisko pukaaro aye baita
Aaja Ali asger banu ka Tha noha Aja Ali asger
4) Teri judaie see baita aankho Mai taariki Hai
Hook se.dil Mai uthti Hai aaga jigar Mai lagti Hai
Aaank laahoo barsa ti Hai
Aja Ali asger banu ka Tha noha aja Ali asger
5). Khaime jaaley asbab lute jalgaya Tere gahwara
Kaise jiyegi maa Teri Kaise jaala kurta Tera
Paadti rahegi ye noha
Aja Ali asger banu ka Tha noha Aja Ali asger
6) ghazi jab bhi paadhta Hai zahid ye Tere noha
Dard Hai kitna nohay Mai kitna haseen tar Hai lehja
Khehte Hai milkar ahele azaaa
Aja Ali asger banu ka Tha noha Aja Ali asger
